title: kith-attach: blob_path assert fires in release builds on bad caller
description: blob_path() now uses assert\! (panics in release) instead of debug_assert\!. The comment says 'every public method calls validate_blob_id before calling this'. But blob_exists() now validates before calling blob_path, and write_blob/write_blob_streaming generate the id internally via generate_blob_id which always produces valid hex. The change from debug_assert to assert means a bug in a new caller (one that bypasses validate) produces a panic in production rather than a debug-only assertion failure. This is intentionally the stricter behavior, but it also means a future caller that passes a user-supplied id without validating will crash the daemon process (panic in async context = task crash, not process crash due to tokio catch_unwind). Worth noting: the assert fires on an unreachable code path in correct usage, which is good; but it should be tested to confirm tokio's catch_unwind behavior.
